steps.content: This is the final round of the game. You don't have much time left to clear it.

<size=32>Indeed, the Dragon of Genesis has never appeared in this world, but everyone you've met during your journey has been the Dragon of Genesis. It's the power the Game Master uses to run this world, connecting to every place and turning every cog.</size>
And now, the power has lost its balance, so the ice and snow begin plaguing the continent. Whether it's for waking up the real Dragon of Genesis or for killing her...
You need to gather those crucial power fragments and gain enough power to fight against her, something in that room...
The icy, chilly wind blows in your face. You stand in a square where the cold wind almost freezes you, the white dice chafing your hand like an ice cube.

The city is entirely covered in ice. All the NPCs you know and don't know have turned into ice sculptures. An even bigger storm is approaching from afar. You recognize the city gate. You're in Wing City.
Each time the Chosen One reincarnates, the world is pushed closer toward its doom. But this time, you're not only the Chosen One. You're a gambler who challenges fate.

steps.speaker: Tetya
steps.content: This way! There's someone alive!
As written in the script, you see those three familiar figures. The two tall ones run in two other directions while Erwin walks toward you with the broken Prism Light.

steps.speaker: Erwin
steps.content: The Forbidden Wall has been breached. The residents must keep retreating...
The two of you are close enough for you to see that tiny bits of ice have already grown on the side of his face.

steps.speaker: Erwin
steps.content: We have 24 hours left until the ice storm sweeps across the entire Isle of Sky... Please retreat as far as possible.
You see Tetya wielding her sword at the completely solidified storm, Hella raising her scepter on the frozen Forbidden Wall, and Tierney piercing her icicle-like longsword into the sky.
As for Erwin, the Prism Light in his hand only flickers occasionally, barely maintaining the protective barrier.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You guys are not leaving?

steps.speaker: Erwin
steps.content: ...Even if the apocalypse is inevitable, we should do our best. Not to mention...

steps.speaker: Erwin
steps.content: The Chosen One hasn't given up either. We must not flee our own battlefield.
The white dice in your hand is warming up. This is an item from Etti, a legacy of the Dragon of Genesis.

The room you saw in that vision told you the truth about this world. If it's really just the projection of the little girl's imagination, then that reward she revealed must exist in this sandbox too, in a place you're very familiar with.
You turn down Erwin's help politely. You know where to go. Your battlefield awaits you.
24 hours, that's your wager. In the final game, you win or you lose, there's no second chance.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Sigh. Who knows I'll be saving the world in a game too.
